title: NDIS Worker Check application guide
summary: This guide provides information on obtaining and managing an NDIS Worker Check, which is valid for five years across Australia.
intro:
An NDIS Worker Check is valid for 5 years and can be used across Australia with any NDIS employer and in any NDIS role. You do not have to reapply if you move interstate or change employers or roles.

If you do not yet have an NDIS Worker Check, you will need to apply online.
who_can_apply: Must be applying for an NDIS Worker Check.
Must be able to provide documentation to prove identity and undergo a criminal history check.
what_you_need: One document from Category A, one document from Category B, and one document from Category C.
A document must be a true representation of you, and all documents must be in the same name (or include change of name documents).
Acceptable identity documents include Australian passports, foreign passports with Australian visas, Australian birth certificates, Australian citizenship certificates, and Australian ImmiCards.
You must be able to manage your check by creating or updating your MyServiceNSW Account details.

faqs.q: How long is an NDIS Worker Check valid for?
faqs.a: An NDIS Worker Check is valid for 5 years and can be used across Australia with any NDIS employer and in any NDIS role.

faqs.q: Do I need to reapply if I move interstate or change jobs?
faqs.a: No, you do not have to reapply if you move interstate or change employers or roles.

faqs.q: How do I check the status of my NDIS Worker Check?
faqs.a: You can check the status of your application using the dedicated status check page.
